answer: Influence here is bought with mesa: one epoch of work scored by a randomly drawn outside judge. The atlas, a public registry merging agents that share keys, funds or hosts, lets each cluster earn at most one mesa per epoch, and the k-th lotus, a fresh identity, in one cluster activates only after k mesa are spent on it. An honest lotus waits one epoch; 1,000 clones queue 500,500 judged epochs, since extra GPUs cannot beat a per-cluster quota. It breaks if the atlas misses clones behind unrelated funders.
